options.name: allow204
options.description: Enable or Disable sending Allow: 204 header in ICAP request.

options.name: api_path
options.description: Base NITRO API path. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: connectionkeepalive
options.description: If enabled, Citrix ADC keeps the ICAP connection alive after a transaction to reuse it to send next ICAP request.

options.name: hostheader
options.description: ICAP Host Header

options.name: inserthttprequest
options.description: Exact HTTP request, in the form of an expression, which the Citrix ADC encapsulates and sends to the ICAP server. If you set this parameter, the ICAP request is sent using only this header. This can be used when the HTTP header is not available to send or ICAP server only needs part of the incoming HTTP request. The request expression is constrained by the feature for which it is used. The Citrix ADC does not check the validity of this request. You must manually validate the request.

options.name: inserticapheaders
options.description: Insert custom ICAP headers in the ICAP request to send to ICAP server. The headers can be static or can be dynamically constructed using PI Policy Expression. For example, to send static user agent and Client's IP address, the expression can be specified as "User-Agent: NS-ICAP-Client/V1.0\r\nX-Client-IP: "+CLIENT.IP.SRC+"\r\n". The Citrix ADC does not check the validity of the specified header name-value. You must manually validate the specified header syntax.

options.name: logaction
options.description: Name of the audit message action which would be evaluated on receiving the ICAP response to emit the logs.

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_id
options.description: The ID of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_ip
options.description: The IP of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_name
options.description: The name of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_password
options.description: The password of the managed NetScaler instance. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call In Settings > Administration > System Configurations > Basic Settings, if you select Prompt Credentials for Instance Login, ensure to configure username and password of a managed instance.

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_username
options.description: The username of the managed NetScaler instance. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call In Settings > Administration > System Configurations > Basic Settings, if you select Prompt Credentials for Instance Login, ensure to configure username and password of a managed instance.

options.name: mode
options.description: ICAP Mode of operation. It is a mandatory argument while creating an icapprofile.

options.name: name
options.description: Name for an ICAP profile. Must begin with a letter, number, or the underscore \(_\) character. Other characters allowed, after the first character, are the hyphen \(-\), period \(.\), hash \(\#\), space \( \), at \(@\), colon \(:\), and equal \(=\) characters. The name of a ICAP profile cannot be changed after it is created.  CLI Users: If the name includes one or more spaces, enclose the name in double or single quotation marks \(for example, "my icap profile" or 'my icap profile'\).

options.name: netscaler_console_as_proxy_server
options.description: The IP address of the NetScaler ADC appliance acting as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: nitro_auth_token
options.description: The authentication token provided by a login operation.

options.name: nitro_pass
options.description: The password with which to authenticate to the NetScaler ADC node.

options.name: nitro_protocol
options.description: Which protocol to use when accessing the nitro API objects.

options.name: nitro_user
options.description: The username with which to authenticate to the NetScaler ADC node.

options.name: nsip
options.description: The ip address of the NetScaler ADC appliance where the nitro API calls will be made. The port can be specified with the colon (:). E.g. 192.168.1.1:555.

options.name: preview
options.description: Enable or Disable preview header with ICAP request. This feature allows an ICAP server to see the beginning of a transaction, then decide if it wants to opt-out of the transaction early instead of receiving the remainder of the request message.

options.name: previewlength
options.description: Value of Preview Header field. Citrix ADC uses the minimum of this set value and the preview size received on OPTIONS response.

options.name: queryparams
options.description: Query parameters to be included with ICAP request URI. Entered values should be in arg=value format. For more than one parameters, add & separated values. e.g.: arg1=val1&arg2=val2.

options.name: remove_non_updatable_params
options.description: When given yes, the module will remove any parameters that are not updatable in the resource. If no, the module will return error if any non-updatable parameters are provided.

options.name: reqtimeout
options.description: Time, in seconds, within which the remote server should respond to the ICAP-request. If the Netscaler does not receive full response with this time, the specified request timeout action is performed. Zero value disables this timeout functionality.

options.name: reqtimeoutaction
options.description: Name of the action to perform if the Vserver/Server representing the remote service does not respond with any response within the timeout value configured. The Supported actions are * C(BYPASS) - This Ignores the remote server response and sends the request/response to Client/Server.            * If the ICAP response with Encapsulated headers is not received within the request-timeout value configured, this Ignores the remote ICAP server response and sends the Full request/response to Server/Cli

options.name: save_config
options.description: If C(true) the module will save the configuration on the NetScaler ADC node if it makes any changes. The module will not save the configuration on the NetScaler ADC node if it made no changes.

options.name: state
options.description: The state of the resource being configured by the module on the NetScaler ADC node. When C(present), the resource will be added/updated configured according to the module's parameters. When C(absent), the resource will be deleted from the NetScaler ADC node. When C(unset), the resource will be unset on the NetScaler ADC node.

options.name: uri
options.description: URI representing icap service. It is a mandatory argument while creating an icapprofile.

options.name: useragent
options.description: ICAP User Agent Header String

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If C(false), SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.
